name: explainer-film
description: Make narrated, fact-checked explainer films for phone screens, chapter by chapter: research and script, voice and word timing, paintings turned into 3D rooms, places built in Blender and painted over, cinematic pages timed to every spoken word, independent fact checks and critique by helper agents, filming and finishing; with calculators that work out the camera, slides, lettering, light, smoke, paintings, timing, sound, filming time and money from the film's own files, a preflight check at every stage, and a tips guide for models.
